name: Sean McCann

bio.education: BA political science, Western Michigan University (1993)
bio.career: Neighbourhood-association director and Kalamazoo Red Cross staffer before a long career in elected office; chairs Michigan Senate Energy & Environment Committee
bio.prior_office: Kalamazoo City Commission (1999-2009); Michigan House, 60th district (2011-2014); Michigan Senate (2019-2026)

McCann was the DCCC Red-to-Blue, New Dem, Whitmer and Slotkin-backed pick running on ACA credits and affordability.

EPD.note: State senator (2019-26) and former state rep/city commissioner; BA only; authored state legislative record (energy committee chair, 2023 clean-energy law) plus a specific federal 'McCann Plan' on ethics (stock-trading ban, revolving-door ban, travel-perk limits).

EO.note: UNKNOWN rather than documented refusal: no McCann-Huizenga general-election debate or forum found (Wikipedia race page lists none; Michigan Public/WMUK coverage shows only rallies and press events). Media: local interviews (WMUK, ABC57, Semafor); no hostile-outlet appearances found. Engages Huizenga's voting record directly, but was noncommittal when asked about continued military aid to Israel and declined to disclose his Senate-primary vote.

notable_positions: 'McCann Plan': ban members of Congress and the president from owning/trading stocks, bar ex-members from lobbying, end luxury taxpayer-funded travel (https://www.wmuk.org/wmuk-news/2026-08-28/sean-mccann-says-hell-fight-for-affordability-and-against-corruption-if-hes-elected-to-congress)

Health care: extend ACA premium tax credits and protect Medicaid; cites his state vote to expand Medicaid (https://ictnews.org/politics/election-2026/two-potawatomi-candidates-facing-off-in-michigan-primary/)

Undecided on continued military aid to Israel; says Congress must 'scrutinize' US Israel policy and voiced concern about the Netanyahu government and loss of life in Gaza (https://www.wmuk.org/wmuk-news/2026-08-28/sean-mccann-says-hell-fight-for-affordability-and-against-corruption-if-hes-elected-to-congress)

Voted for Michigan's 2023 clean-energy standard (100% clean by 2040) and still backs it; supports reopening the Palisades nuclear plant (https://www.mackinac.org/blog/2026/mccann-huizenga-fuel-up-in-close-campaign)

Blames Trump tariffs for higher prices and called the Iran conflict an 'unnecessary war' (https://abc57.com/news/abc57-sat-down-with-candidates-for-michigans-4th-congressional-district-ahead-of-the-primary-election)
rationale: No left-ideology markers found (LI 0) and only moderate centrist signals (New Dem endorsement, Republican endorsements; CI 2), so he falls to the EPD/EO tests. He is credentialed by office (EPD 5); the Cat 3 call rests on the absence of any documented general-election debate and some evasive answers (Israel aid, Senate-primary vote). If evidence of a debate emerges, he would move to the 'imperfect fit' bucket nearest Cat 4.
